correctness.rationale: The displayed fifteen coordinate-pairing lines satisfy the cubic; six Galois-paired branches are generated by explicit vectors over A=R[T]/(T²+T−1). A unique characteristic-five ordinary node follows from equal squared coordinate partial derivatives. The node-line directions are six transverse solutions of a conic–cubic intersection, giving six geometric node-lines. The rank-four cubic section on relative Gr(2,4) has 27 as its top Chern number; finiteness, lci and flatness plus rank-three tangent equations force six local Artin rings each length exactly two. The normalized Pluecker coordinate equals T and detects the nonzero nilpotent, so the integral map is an isomorphism by special-fiber comparison and Nakayama. Independent enumeration of all 806 F5-lines in P3 found exactly 21 rational cubic line supports, six through the singular node; this does not replace the scheme-theoretic proof.
